brainScreen.basis: Entire source brain PMS 423c screen face, measured from CAD triangles.

lift.reason: STEP AP214 has placed parts but no kinematic constraints or motion limits. Static pose retained.

claw.type: linked jaws driven around source Y axis
claw.reason: Claw components and shaft are present; complete linkage pivot set and permitted travel are not exported. Static pose retained.

heldGamePiece.basis: Native-scale pin placed in measured front jaw cavity. Pin quarter-turn uses its symmetric circular section between the source rubber bands. Translation chosen from sampled collision-free poses; this is a display attachment, not a measured kinematic constraint or certified grasp.
heldGamePiece.limitations: Cross-section surface intersection sampling is geometric evidence, not an exhaustive solid collision or force-closure proof. Lift/claw remain in the supplied pose.
